name: Dissonant Whispers
summary: Deals Psychic damage to a creature and makes it use its Reaction to flee from you.

stats.effect: One creature of your choice that you can see within range hears a discordant melody in its mind. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 Psychic damage and must immediately use its {ref:glossary/reaction}, if available, to move as far away from you as it can, using the safest route. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.
stats.higherLevels: The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 1.
